title: DiSECt to reliable robot slicing and learning — execution checklist
scope: Component passes are distinct from settled tomato, successful cutting, robot integration and training. Original run remains paused.

items.task: Preserve the original simulation and checkpoint 6,925.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Original robot, kitchen, grip and motion interface remain unchanged.

items.task: Profile the original solver and compare candidate engines.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Recorded component timings and differences in models/resolution; no equal-accuracy speedup claim.

items.task: Get DiSECt examples running with clean exits.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Two corrected-candidate prism repeats complete normally; forward-only qualification.

items.task: Repair and independently validate prism cut surfaces.
items.acceptance_or_limit: No duplicate/degenerate cut faces, full section coverage, physical spring arrays preserved.

items.task: Build and validate the separate tomato FEM mesh.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Original exterior, total mass, cut location and 25 support coordinates retained; internal resolution changed.

items.task: Identify the explicit timestep limit and correct hydrostatic damping.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Relative-velocity correction is isolated and versioned; coefficients were not reduced to pass.

items.task: Verify translation and resolved-signal damping controls.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Low-signal affine precision remains failed and must not be inferred from these scoped passes.

items.task: Complete a one-second finite tomato gravity hold.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Historical finite hold preserved. Later corrected-law intact settling now passes in section3; live cutting assembly still unqualified.

items.task: Fix tiny movements being lost during position updates.
items.acceptance_or_limit: PASS in isolated float64 numerical adapter. 100,000 observed tiny updates match analytic translation within 5.2e-13m; original geometry, masses, material and supports preserved.

items.task: Verify the fix against independent motion references and resets.
items.acceptance_or_limit: PASS: independent translation/free-fall/analytic oscillator references; four-node dense implicit solve; full-mesh execution equivalence and reset/allocation controls. Added state clears on reset. Forward-only, not autograd qualification.

items.task: Establish trustworthy small-force precision.
items.acceptance_or_limit: PASS in tested computational range: independent float64 force checks from ~1.1e-8N to .011N, with declared 1e-10N absolute floor. Old float32 low-signal failure is preserved; no experimental calibration claim.

items.task: Establish a stable, sufficiently fast integration method.
items.acceptance_or_limit: COST FAILED / OPEN: accurate 20ms IMEX result meets 0.1mm/5% limits (0.00518mm, 0.677% material force) but costs ~272 wall s/s; optimistic output-free lower bound ~251 exceeds the prospective120 budget. Final execution optimization is slower. Bounded study stopped; do not mark this check or the full section complete.

stages.title: Before blade contact

items.task: Pass the complete unloaded settling check.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Both fresh one-second holds pass, including the half-step comparison. Late speed is 0.0965 mm/s against a 1 mm/s limit. Position difference is 0.000383 mm; force differences are below 0.03%. Applies to the intact tomato only.

items.task: Validate board contact and sustained target support.
items.acceptance_or_limit: The finite board footprint and 25 fixed support points sustain the target, with no sampled board penetration or support drift. This uses an uncalibrated contact model with a 1 mm contact offset; equivalence to the original board mechanics remains pending.

items.task: Prepare and validate the tomato cutting interface.
items.acceptance_or_limit: The approved split preserves mass, outside shape and support locations. Paired cut faces and static material checks pass. Live breakable connections and the dynamics of very small cells remain unqualified. The earlier candidate added 9.115% mass and was rejected.

items.task: Define the fracture law and its timestep dependence.
items.acceptance_or_limit: The fracture rule and its dependence on timestep are documented and analytically checked. A separate proposal preserves the original 47 cohesive patch groups. These are definitions and offline input checks; neither is a validated live tomato fracture model.

items.task: Verify knife representation, nonfracturing contact and force reporting.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Original blade geometry and independent contact controls pass. Both gentle probes loaded, withdrew horizontally and unloaded stably. Force and moment differences reached 10.08% and 10.23%, exceeding the 5% limit. This check remains open; no robot or cutting qualification follows.

stages.note: 3 verified · force refinement and live interface open

items.task: Pass a shallow scripted cut and controlled stop.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Use progressive contact-driven material failure, saved force/deformation/geometry traces and declared stops.

items.task: Execute the full stroke and withdraw horizontally toward the robot.
items.acceptance_or_limit: No upward withdrawal through the target; preserve intended blade orientation and clearance.

items.task: Prove actual material separation.
items.acceptance_or_limit: No surviving load-bearing material ties; two intended substantial pieces, not a visible gap or isolated fragments.

items.task: Verify post-withdrawal stability, mass and slice shape.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Observe at least one simulated second after blade clearance; stable board/cut-face contact and no healing.

items.task: Repeat and test resolution, size and path changes.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Repeat from fresh/reset state; refine once, change size once and path once. Distinguish precomputed new interfaces from deviations after preparation; use negative controls for the success evaluator.

items.task: Demonstrate multiple successive slices.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Separate extension requiring supported interface/topology updates and valid remaining-fruit state; one detached cap does not establish repeated slicing.

stages.title: Connect the candidate to the robot

items.task: Connect through the existing motion and reaction interface.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Preserve robot, kitchen and disclosed fixed attachment; no engine adoption before evidence review.

items.task: Recheck actual robot tracking, grip, posture and clearance.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Correct arm motion, natural handle grip and backward/outward elbow; no per-frame teleportation to manufacture tracking.

items.task: Validate mounted-blade feedback and loaded support.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Verify reaction signs, origins, clocks and native articulation response; strict force/work qualification remains a separate open research gate.

items.task: Pass clean loaded, failed-episode and post-cut resets.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Clear both engine states, numerical compensation, material history, contact/wrench queues, clocks and observations; compare to fresh launch.

items.task: Freeze observations, actions, rewards, stops and success evaluation.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Same API/evaluator for scripted and learned methods; evaluator-only fracture/connectivity truth must not leak into actor inputs.

items.task: Collect successful scripted demonstrations and split the data.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Record action labels and provenance; keep independent development/held-out cases separate.

items.task: Train and evaluate imitation of the verified baseline.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Start with the narrow supported task; measure closed-loop success and runtime before expansion.

items.task: Train bounded learned corrections and compare fairly.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Constrain supported path deviations; pair with scripted baselines on held-out cases, report uncertainty, forces, geometry, failures and compute cost.

items.task: Compare against independent measured tomato experiments.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Remains pending by user decision; synthetic simulation development must not be described as experimental validation.

items.task: Qualify contact-based left-hand support.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Test load retention/slip first; remove hidden rigid-fixture support before claiming hand stabilization.

items.task: Coordinate both arms with verified clearance and failure handling.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Support -> cut -> horizontal withdrawal -> release; stop safely on support loss and verify reset.

items.task: Compare dual-arm and fixed-fixture cutting.
items.acceptance_or_limit: Use matched cases and report force, slip, drift, clearance, cut quality, reliability and cost.

current_work.title: Research reference retained; engine adoption deferred.
current_work.description: Current feasibility branch stopped: contact is too slow, force refinement failed, and live cutting remains unqualified. Verified component results stay recorded. Read the decision before any further solver development.

latest_precontact.scope: Bounded section 3 prerequisites; no actual cutting, native robot qualification or engine adoption

settling.scope: Corrected-law intact1s finite-board hold and half-step check only; not new cut assembly

probe.scope: Exact-original-CAD prescribed nonfracturing contact on intact FEM; node-collocated surface contact, NOT new cut-assembly/native robot/full separation qualification

latest_precontact.remaining_gate: Blade force/moment refinement failed; live original-cohesive assembly and small-cell qualification pending
